performance.verdict: SOW delivery is the crisis; paid spend is secondary and recovering.

findings.text: 10 of 10 SOW milestones are overdue — earliest was due 2026-07-31, latest 2026-09-30 — blocking attribution, tracking, and campaign go-live across all departments.
CPL spiked 83.52% WoW while leads fell 66.67%; spend cut 38.83% is the proximate cause — CPL inflated because fixed platform minimums erode efficiency at low budgets.
3-day signal (Sep 29–Oct 1): spend recovered to $50–52/day and leads returned (6, 9, 2), reversing the Sep 21–23 zero-spend dropout — trend is stabilising, not collapsing.

GA4 sessions collapsed from ~148/day (Sep 14–18 peak) to 19–62/day in the last 10 days (-56.28% WoW), tracking the spend drop — but GA4 zero conversions for 45 days signals broken pixel, not zero intent.
GBP actions fell 26.67% WoW; last 2 days show 0 actions, consistent with Sep 21–23 zero-spend dark period suppressing brand searches locally — GHL pipeline is null, so intake flow is unverifiable.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 10 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer and Sohib immediately; block Phase 2 conversation until pre-launch stack test is complete.
suggestions.monday_update: All 10 SOW milestones are confirmed overdue, the earliest by 63 days (due 2026-07-31). Nacer (Ops) and Sohib (Account) must triage blockers in order: pre-launch stack test → GHL migration → Meta CAPI → landing pages/tracking → search campaigns → LSA. Success is defined as at least the five July-31 milestones marked complete or formally re-scoped by 2026-10-09. Phase 2 conversation (due 2026-09-30, also overdue) does not open until Phase 1 delivery is verified.

suggestions.text: Audit and repair GA4 conversion pixel — 45 consecutive days of zero conversions on 2,795 sessions confirms a broken event, not zero intent.
suggestions.monday_update: GA4 shows 2,795 sessions over 28 days but zero conversions recorded for the full 45-day series — this is a broken pixel, not a traffic problem. The Web/Creative team must locate and fire the conversion event (appointment booking or form submit) correctly in GA4. Success is at least one verified conversion event firing in GA4 within 3 days of the fix, confirmed via DebugView. Re-check 2026-10-05.

suggestions.text: Watch Meta CPL over next 3 days at recovered $47–53/day spend before any budget move; confirm CPL returns toward 28-day baseline of $5.79.
suggestions.monday_update: Spend recovered to ~$47–53/day on Sep 29–Oct 1 after a 3-day zero-spend dropout (Sep 21–23) that caused CPL to spike 83.52% WoW. The 3-day lead return (6, 9, 2 leads) is encouraging but Oct 1 dropped to 2 leads at $47 spend. Do not adjust budget until 3 consecutive days confirm CPL is trending back toward the 28-day baseline of $5.79. Re-check 2026-10-05.
